items.title: ‘We are committed Christians’: Our son and daughter-in-law cut us out of their lives after a political argument. Should we change our $3 million will?
items.description: “We are hurt and confused, but we have also tried to respect the boundaries they have established.”

items.title: States are coming after prediction markets — and setting up a costly legal battle over who gets to regulate them
items.description: Prediction markets like Kalshi are regulated in different ways across states. There’s a better way for them to thrive.

items.title: ‘This is very stressful’: My son’s roof was damaged in a storm, but his insurance won’t pay. Can he fight this?
items.description: “They’re saying the roof now needs to be completely replaced.”

items.title: Our 4-year-old son has $100,000 in his 529 account. Is a bull market a bad time to buy him stocks instead?
items.description: “I’d love for our son to be able to attend college without needing to take out student loans.”

items.title: Social Security union says it needs $3 billion and another 20,000 workers to fix long wait times and ‘ghost offices’
items.description: “The public is going to have a harder and harder time accessing these benefits,” union official said.

items.title: ‘There is considerable tension’: My grandmother, 99, wants to cut my mother out of her will. Should I intervene?
items.description: “Grandma feels that she was pressured by my mother into taking out a $50,000 HELOC.”

items.title: Nvidia earnings could rescue a stalled-out stock market — if the AI chip maker breaks this trend
items.description: Shares of Jensen Huang’s company have struggled to make headway since its previous results day.

items.title: I hold my mother-in-law’s power of attorney. I’m also her executor and trustee. Do I have too much power over her affairs?
items.description: “There is a lot of legal and financial power in my hands.”

items.title: ‘It’s truly a tragedy’: My daughter hasn’t spoken to me for 4 years, but it has nothing to do with politics
items.description: “You’ll have to trust me when I tell you that she had love, support and opportunities.”

items.title: I need to get out of my job. Can I leave for a competitor if I’ve signed a non-compete?
